text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - U.S. grain export sources said on Wednesday that India bought at least one million tonnes of Australian wheat in the past 24 hours. The sale was divided into three shipments of 250,000 for August shipment, 250,000 tonnes for November and 500,000 tonnes for December, a trader said.
The deals were done at $154.25 to $155 per tonne, FOB.
European grain traders said the shipment dates were August and October for 250,000 tonnes each and December for 500,000 tonnes. But there was was no official confirmation yet.

WHEAT SALE - Algeria on Wednesday bought 75,000 tonnes of European Union wheat for April/May shipment at around $180 per tonne, a price that equates to $160 or $161 per tonne FOB France, grain traders said. One trader said the wheat would be of European Union origin, while another senior trader said it was almost certain to come from France.

- South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd said on Wednesday they bought combined 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Nichimen Corp. Shipment was set for May 5-June 5 to the port of Inchon.
WHEAT SALES - South Korea bought 24,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Mitsui and Co Ltd. Shipment was set for May 15-June 15 to Inchon.

WHEAT SALE - The Canadian Wheat Board sold more than 500,000 tonnes of mostly hard red spring wheat to Iran and more than 100,000 tonnes of hard red spring wheat to the Phillipines, grain trade sources said. The CWB sold more than 500,000 tonnes of mostly Canada Western Red Spring and some Western Canada Prairie Spring wheat to Iran for May/June delivery, the source said, citing Vancouver vessel manifests.

CORN SALE - South Korea bought 105,000 tonnes of corn from Cargill on Monday, 52,500 tonnes U.S. No.2 corn at $147.50 a tonne C&F for July 20 arrival and 52,500 tonnes at $147.75 a tonne C&F U.S./$145 a tonne C&F Argentina for Aug 10 arrival.
COTTONSEED MEAL SALE - South Korea bought 24,000 tonnes of Chinese and 19,500 tonnes of Australian cottonseed meal.
WHEAT TENDER - Iraq is still negotiating for 50,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat and a reply is expected this week.
- France will hold a tender on March 26 to sell 3,000 tonnes of soft wheat to Iraq via the Rome-based World Food Programme, for April 8-30 shipment.
WHEAT TENDER - Cyprus changed the deadline for the submission of tenders for 10,000 tonnes spring and 8,000 tonnes durum wheat to March 27.
VEGOIL TENDER - Egypt seeks up to 45,000 tonnes of vegetable oils for May delivery. The deadline for bids was April 2.
BARLEY TENDER - The South African Wheat Board said it was offering 25,150 tonnes of feed grade barley for export sale no later than April 30.
RICE TENDER - Syria seeks 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment between April 20 and May 20. April 8 is the final date for bids and result will be announced on April 16.
MARKET TALK - Thailand and Malaysia may soon be in the market for at least 250,000 tonnes of corn from either Argentina or China, regional traders said on Wednesday.

Trade sources in Bangkok said the government had approved a zero-tariff corn import quota of 200,000 tonnes for 1997 and feedmillers were poised to begin filing their orders. Thailand wants the corn to arrive before the end of June.
... Surging demand from China and low domestic consumption will keep Indian soymeal exports in 1996/97 at last year's levels despite a lower crop forecast, exporters said.
